Retaining Ring · Grip Type

G-Type Retaining Rings (Grip Rings)

A retaining ring that fits directly onto a shaft without any groove machining, holding its position using only the ring's own grip force (friction). Since no separate groove needs to be cut into the shaft, it can be mounted freely at any desired position, but it is not suitable for applications subject to strong axial loads like the C-type or E-type. The spec symbol is written as GTW.
